nativeBaseline.reference: two native range inputs with independently named values

library: Coordinate two native ranges with one ordered value pair and a shared min/max/step grid; preserve thumb identity at bounds.
Expose valid dynamic native bounds and controlled change requests; preserve native range focus and keyboard behavior.
consumer: Author separately localized accessible names for both inputs, their units/value text, and any form names.
For Elements, author native range markup and matching initial values for pre-upgrade semantics.

notes: The chosen contract is two coordinated native range inputs, not an overlaid custom multi-thumb slider.

React/Vue require startLabel/endLabel; Angular and Elements use authored native input labels. Native form submission and disabled exclusion are tested; reset, external form integration, touch target/visual, cross-browser and manual AT evidence remain open.
Audit mapping remains provisional; not a conformance claim.
